# everpure_azure_snapshot (List Resource)

Lists the Snapshots in a Volume Group, so they can be brought under Terraform with `terraform query`. Only live, manually created snapshots are listed: the ones the `everpure_azure_snapshot` resource can manage.

List resources require Terraform 1.14 or later, and importing the results by identity requires 1.12 or later. Results are sorted newest first, by `created_at`.

`terraform query -generate-config-out=<file>` writes an `import` block and a `resource` block for each result. `include_resource = true` additionally shows each result's attributes in the query output.

A `list` block returns at most 100 results by default and gives no warning when it stops there. Set the block's `limit` argument to raise the cap.

`volume_snapshots` is null in list results. To see it, import the snapshot or read it with the [`everpure_azure_snapshot` data source](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/data-sources/snapshot).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Save as discover.tfquery.hcl next to your configuration, then run
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
# to write an import block and a resource block for every snapshot found.

list "everpure_azure_snapshot" "all" {
  provider         = everpure
  include_resource = true

  config {
    volume_group_id = "/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/rg-storage-prod/providers/PureStorage.Block/storagePools/pool-prod-east/volumeGroups/vg-prod-east"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `volume_group_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the volume group to list snapshots in. Must be in the provider's own `subscription_id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `list` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when listing the snapshots.
